About the role
Acme Payments is hiring a Java Backend Developer in Bengaluru to build payment APIs.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot
- Work with PostgreSQL and MySQL databases
- Collaborate in an Agile team using Git

Requirements
- 0-2 years of experience in backend development
- Strong knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate and SQL
- Experience with REST APIs
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

Nice to have
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- Experience with Kafka
